architecture_philosophy.objective: To provide high-fidelity, standardized transit data for automated stop projection and polyline interpolation. The dataset ensures that every movement is strictly directional relative to the Purulia Central Hub.

hitl_realtime_schema.gtfs_style_temporal_architecture: To ensure absolute flexibility for unpredictable rural bus dynamics (e.g. 15-minute load halts), the legacy single 'time' string was converted to explicit 'arrival_time' and 'departure_time' fields. This allows intermediate stops to possess layover durations without fracturing established trip_id sequences.
hitl_realtime_schema.crowdsourced_learning_block: Every stop now contains a 'hitl_learning' object. It acts as a permanent partition between official union schedules and community-verified empirical offsets, anchoring the real-time application telemetry.

trip_sequencing.logic: Represents the absolute chronological sequence of service legs performed by a bus during its operational day. The '1st trip' identifies the initial departure from the overnight origin or starting hub. All subsequent movements are logically chained in time-order.

purulia_centric_routes.rule: For any bus whose route includes 'Purulia' as a stoppage, direction must be standardized using Hub-relative logic.
purulia_centric_routes.definitions: 'UP' signifies inbound movement towards Purulia (Destination: Purulia). 'DOWN' signifies outbound movement originating from or moving away from Purulia (Origin: Purulia).

non_purulia_bypass_routes.rule: For buses that do NOT have a 'Purulia' stoppage in their entire itinerary, the UP/DOWN nomenclature is substituted for destination-explicit naming.
non_purulia_bypass_routes.definitions: Direction is explicitly defined using the 'towards [Destination]' format (e.g., 'towards Khatra') to prevent spatial ambiguity in bypass movements.

automated_pivot_splitting_logic.the_pivot_rule: The dataset enforces a 'No Hub-Through' rule. Purulia is strictly prohibited from being an intermediate stop in any single movement.
automated_pivot_splitting_logic.transformation_process: Routes that originally bypassed Purulia as a midpoint (e.g., Jhalda -> Bankura) have been programmatically split at the 'Purulia' pivot point into two discrete, sequential movements: Inbound (Jhalda -> Purulia = UP) and Outbound (Purulia -> Bankura = DOWN).

multiple_trip_chronology_and_rebounds.cycle_definition: A vehicle's full operational day is fractionalized into discrete, one-way 'movements'. A complete round-trip cycle consists of two sequentially paired movements.
multiple_trip_chronology_and_rebounds.rebound_inversion_logic: For return trips (e.g., 2nd trip, 4th trip), the 'stops' array is geographically inverted. The previous destination becomes the new origin, ensuring the timeline reads chronologically forward.

structural_integrity_rules.terminal_anchoring: The 'Origin' of a movement must identically match the first entry in the 'stops' array. The 'Destination' must match the last entry.
structural_integrity_rules.spatial_continuity: Strict terminal continuity: The 'Destination' of trip 'n' MUST match the 'Origin' of trip 'n+1'. This guarantees unbroken spatial tracking.
structural_integrity_rules.temporal_monotonicity: Stop times within a trip must follow a strictly increasing chronological order (allowing for 'null' gaps).

data_quality_and_reliability_framework.class_a_verified: Ground-truth data derived from physical surveys or official RTO/Bus Association schedules. Highest reliability.
data_quality_and_reliability_framework.class_b_interpolated: Geographically accurate routes where intermediate timings have been projected based on segment averages to ensure data continuity.
data_quality_and_reliability_framework.class_c_synthetic: Dummy/Test data used for pipeline validation and UI debugging. Identified by 'WB0000...' registration numbers.

bus_object.reg_no: Unique legal registration number (Primary Key). Format: 'WBXXYYYY' or 'WB0000...' for test data.
bus_object.primary_hub: The primary operational anchor or base for the bus service.
bus_object.movements: An ordered array of 'movement' trips capturing the full daily cycle.

movement_object.trip_id: Ordinal chronological index (1st trip, 2nd trip, etc.).
movement_object.stops: Ordered array of stop objects: { 'name': string, 'time': 'HH:MM AM/PM' | null }.
movement_object.time_null_handling: A 'null' time indicates an 'on-call' or 'flag' stoppage where the bus passes through but has no fixed scheduled arrival time.

special_handling_notes.bypass_routes: A subset of routes that bypass Purulia district center are classified by their primary travel direction relative to the district center while following bypass-specific naming rules.
special_handling_notes.timing_projection: Timing expansion logic is used to fill gaps in L3/L4 service legs based on validated L1/L2 physical durations.

test_bus_registry.description: Explicit UI/API test buses pinned for routing and polyline regression checks.
